test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five friends, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. U is the immediate neighbour of Q and S. T is second to the left of U and an immediate neighbour of both R and S. Where is R seated?

options.text: To the immediate right of T
Third to the left of S
Second to the left of U
Third to the left of U

solution:
Given: Five friends, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) T is second to the left of U and an immediate neighbour of both R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7e400b8eafb611897a6f17172f33846da7ee5eff9b57713751ef6a4433a772a.png] 

2) U is the immediate neighbour of Q and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5dfdc202e9e36e47fd668e93d179d9d3f63ec76434450851c3954c9b0dd4364.png] 

So, R is seated at the** third to the left of U.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Third to the left of U".**
